_doc: The three-dimension proposal as data (COMMAND_CENTER.md). Ladders: each dimension's tiers, coarse to fine. execution_rules: how a stored row becomes an execution stop (stop_counts.py). kinds: every registry kind placed in each dimension. surfaces: every current level, tier, view, panel and control, with its new home or 'dropped' or 'owner' (an open choice). map_surfaces.py fails when a current surface has no entry here. Proposal only: nothing reads this at runtime.

cuda runtime call.execution: kernel (CPU side) if a launch, else detail

cuda driver call.execution: kernel (CPU side) if a launch, else detail

python call.execution: module if a module forward, else detail

tier:request.new: execution / request; container events move to architecture / container

tier:op.new: execution / module (nested NVTX); graph nodes to detail

tier:call.new: split: module forwards to execution / module, launches to the CPU side of execution / kernel, the rest to detail

v3 level:Infra.new: architecture / container and process; hardware / node strip moves to the hardware dimension

v3 level:Components.new: architecture / component, with execution / phase lighting the boxes

v3 level:Kernel.new: execution / kernel, with hardware / kernel traffic beside it

v2 level:Infrastructure.new: architecture / container and process, built natively from the v2-scene branch level (no v1 panel)

v2 level:Components.new: architecture / component, built natively from the v2-scene branch level (no v1 panel)

v2 level:Hardware.new: hardware / unit and kernel traffic (the SM view)

v1 view:runs.new: header session shell: Load (replay a run)

v1 view:run.new: header session shell: Launch (live); results in the Rep world

v1 view:compare.new: header session shell: Compare; Rep world side by side, A / B switch in other worlds

v1 view:infra.new: architecture / container and process, hardware / system

v1 view:lifecycle.new: control plane (bottom), outside the world; container events stay architecture / container stops

v1 view:tools.new: control plane (bottom); run-specific containers (Grafana, Prometheus, DCGM, node exporter) are in the run's world as architecture / container

panel:sidebar.new: hardware / system, persistent in every view

panel:inspector.new: detail of the selection in any dimension; holds every detail row

panel:bar.new: the timeline strip: ticks are the stops of the focused (dimension, tier)

control:next event at the grain.new: next stop at the focused (dimension, tier)

control:previous event at the grain.new: previous stop at the focused (dimension, tier)

control:next event one tier coarser.new: next stop one tier coarser in the same dimension

control:previous event one tier coarser.new: previous stop one tier coarser in the same dimension

control:next row of any tier (every row).new: kept (owner): walk every row of the focused tier in time order, or only the rows of the selected process or object

control:previous row of any tier.new: kept (owner): same two modes as the forward walk

control:focus the next coarser level.new: fly one tier coarser in the focused dimension

control:focus the next finer level.new: fly one tier finer in the focused dimension

control:focus <level> (keys 1-7).new: fly to tier n of the focused dimension; a separate key picks the dimension (fly model, section 3.4)

control:play / pause.new: unchanged: plays stops of the focused (dimension, tier)

control:natural window of the focused le.new: natural window of the focused (dimension, tier)

control:first event at the grain.new: first stop at the focused (dimension, tier)

control:last event at the grain.new: last stop at the focused (dimension, tier)
